caption: The drawing features a metal utensil with a round, shallow bowl supported by three short legs, allowing it to stand upright. Attached to the side of the bowl is a long, straight handle that extends diagonally upward and outward, ending in a circular hole. The color of the utensil is a dark metallic brown, with dull highlights and subtle shading indicating light reflection and the texture of the material. The shadow of the object falls to the right and slightly downward. The background is an off-white or light beige color, and the object is centrally positioned with a small technical sketch and some text in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Sauce Pan
